title: johrenia longifolia
intro: Johrenia longifolia, commonly known as Wild Carrot or Long-leaved Johrenia, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in alleviating digestive issues, such as bloating and indigestion, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Johrenia longifolia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Johrenia longifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
